title: refactor(types)!: delete the api-types module and its eight names nothing reads

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoLQhgY6iJkR5KDjYN9qtpcw)_

Part of #25921 (batch 9, claim 6688016193 with amendments naming the branch and 6688131809 naming the batch; the card's other open items stay on it)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：从 `@object-ui/types` 整个删除 `api-types.ts` 模块及入口上的 "API and Events" 一组导出，共 8 个类型（`HTTPMethod`、`APIRequest`、`APIConfig`、`DataFetchConfig`、`DataFetchableSchema`、`ExpressionContext`、`ExpressionNodeSchema`、`APISchema`）。
- 为什么改：#25921 清理零消费者公开面；这 8 个类型描述一套没有任何渲染器、适配器或宿主读取的取数/表达式方言，仓内与 hotcrm 都没有引用（`ExpressionContext` 的外部命中都是 `@object-ui/core` 自己的同名类），留着会被当成 UI 协议包的公开承诺。
- 风险与回滚：只删 TypeScript 类型，运行时零变化；对外部 npm 使用者是破坏性变更，带一个 `!` patch changeset（BREAKING、FROM/TO、ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` 8 个）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/types/src/index.ts`（删掉的导出块，原模块里 objectui#6497 的墓碑按席位裁决 A 移到这里）、`.changeset/25921-types-api-block.md`（迁移说明）、`ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/eventable-schema-retired-6497.test.ts`（钉子改读入口文件）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -lw -e DataFetchableSchema -e APISchema -- ui/packages` 预期只命中 6497 钉子测试和入口里的墓碑注释；`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/` 预期全绿。
- 不在本 PR：`clearSharedDiscoveryCache` 与其它包的 barrel 批次仍挂在 #25921；`types/src/ai.ts` 的 `never` 墓碑按 #25912 规则保留。

## What changes

`@object-ui/types` (its `.` entry) loses the whole `src/api-types.ts` module, which was the entry's "API and Events" block. All 8 names are deleted from the package, not only from the entry:

`HTTPMethod`, `APIRequest`, `APIConfig`, `DataFetchConfig`, `DataFetchableSchema`, `ExpressionContext`, `ExpressionNodeSchema`, `APISchema`.

- `src/api-types.ts`: deleted (342 lines). Its only other content was the objectui#6497 tombstone for `UIEventHandler` / `EventableSchema`.
- `src/index.ts`: the "API and Events" export block is replaced by a comment that names the 8 retired names (#25921) and carries the objectui#6497 tombstone, moved verbatim in substance from the deleted module (seat ruling A, amendment 6688131809). One sentence is reworded (the `dialog` member's action entries) so the barrel does not match the `\.actions\b` anchor of `handler-keys-string-any-mirrors-7344.test.ts`'s prose census.
- `src/__tests__/eventable-schema-retired-6497.test.ts`: see Tests.
- `.changeset/25921-types-api-block.md`: one `!` patch changeset, BREAKING, FROM/TO per group (no replacement in this package; data goes through `DataSource`, expressions through `@object-ui/core`'s `ExpressionEvaluator` and its own `ExpressionContext` class), and the ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` marker naming all 8.

No other module changes shape. `api-types.ts` was reached only through the `.` entry; no subpath entry of the package exported it.

## Tests

The objectui#6497 pin is reshaped per the seat's ruling; every assertion it had that `UIEventHandler` / `EventableSchema` stay unexported is kept, only the file it reads moved:

- Module legs: the two `@ts-expect-error` legs on `import('../api-types')` and their module lit control go with the module; a runtime leg asserts `api-types.ts` does not exist, with the barrel's existence as the lit control on the same probe.
- Declaration check: reads `index.ts` for `export interface|type UIEventHandler` / `EventableSchema` (absent), lit control `AnySchema` on the same matcher; the "tombstone stays" text check reads `index.ts`.
- The `APISchema`-arm check becomes "the barrel's `AnySchema` union carries no `EventableSchema` arm", lit control `BaseSchema` on the same extracted text.
- Barrel legs: both `@ts-expect-error` legs on `import('../index')` stay; type lit controls are now `BaseSchema` and `AnySchema`; the export-list matcher's lit control is `BaseSchema`.
- Tree scan: the `api-types.ts` exclusion row is gone (the file is gone); its `ActionDef` lit control stays.
- Mutation check: restoring `api-types.ts` from `origin/main` reds the module leg ("the DECLARING module is gone…"), 1 failed / 5 passed; removed again, 6 passed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Census (read-only, before any edit; origin/main 1aeeafd9, hotcrm 6961ab1)</summary>

- Tool: the batch 8 census (TS AST of every published `ui/packages/*` main entry; identifier-token index over every tracked file of both repositories minus CHANGELOGs, changesets, the lockfile and release notes; prose and tests count as consumers; then not taught in README/demo/docs and not named by a kept export's declaration). `@object-ui/types`: 724 entry names, 163 zero-outside, 61 candidates.
- 7 of the 8 have 0 hits outside `ui/packages/types/` in either repository (CHANGELOG record lines only).
- `ExpressionContext` has homonym hits only, each resolved to another declaration: core's class `core/src/evaluator/ExpressionContext.ts` (and its evaluator and tests), app-shell's `useExpressionContext` hook and its React-context header comment, and prose naming core's file (`content/docs/frontend/architecture-overview.mdx:207`, `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md:15`). No file importing `@object-ui/types` reads it; hotcrm has 0.
- No zod twin, not an arm of `AnySchema`, no subpath entry, not taught.
- Positive control on the same tool: `BaseSchema` (470 files).
- No pending changeset names any of the 8; none of the 44 open PRs touches `ui/packages/types/`.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs on head 643031bf (base 1aeeafd9)</summary>

- `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS pnpm --filter '@object-ui/types' build` (after removing `dist` and `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`): exit 0, dist completeness 162 files; `dist` has no `api-types.*` and 0 files naming `HTTPMethod`, `DataFetchConfig`, `DataFetchableSchema`, `ExpressionNodeSchema` or `APISchema`; `BaseSchema` is in 63.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` (src, examples, tests; makes the `@ts-expect-error` legs real): exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/`: Test Files 387 passed (387), Tests 10462 passed (10462). The first run went red in one file, `handler-keys-string-any-mirrors-7344.test.ts` (its prose census matched the moved tombstone's `dialog.actions[]` wording in `index.ts`); fixed by the rewording above, then green.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 36 derived families, every line run with stdin closed; `--ran` reconciliation: 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, all exit 0. One of them, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, went red first in `unit-registry-absence-collision.test.ts` ("Failed to resolve entry for package @objectstack/client", no `dist` in this fresh worktree); after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/client...' build` the rerun is Test Files 170 passed, 2 skipped (172), Tests 4991 passed, 2 skipped.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0. `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- Full dogfood (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), head 643031bf: `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test"`: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 427 passed, 3 skipped (430); Tests 3556 passed, 41 skipped (3597).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Still open on #25921 after this batch: `clearSharedDiscoveryCache` (needs a test-support home first) and the other barrel batches. `@object-ui/types` keeps about 53 more candidates (`spec-report.ts` 10, `product-blocks.ts` / `designer.ts` whose census hits are reached through kept unions, `data-protocol.ts` 6, `ui-action.ts` 4, the `@objectstack/spec/ui` re-exports 7 and others). Census and tools: this project's files `ui-seat-3/r2026-11-06/25921-b9-census.md`.
- `types/src/ai.ts` keeps its `never` tombstones until the sunset rule of #25912; not touched here.
